title: 大语言模型中的前景理论：损失厌恶、敏感性递减与概率权重的元分析
summary: 该元分析汇总11项研究、32个语言模型的102个拟合估计，考察LLM是否呈现前景理论三大特征。结果显示：LLM损失厌恶较弱（合并λ=1.26，低于人类最强估计1.96）；价值函数接近线性，敏感性递减依测量方法而异；概率权重呈类人倒S形（γ≈0.81–0.84）。
summary_en: This meta-analysis pools 102 fitted estimates from 11 studies covering 32 language models to test whether LLMs exhibit prospect-theory properties. LLMs show modest loss aversion (pooled λ=1.26 vs. human 1.96), near-linear value functions with method-dependent diminishing sensitivity, but human-like inverse-S probability weighting (γ≈0.81–0.84).
